cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Keep the Peace
cards.instruction: Hide a truth because you believe the relationship cannot survive one more conflict.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The missing savings are a banking complication. Our anniversary dinner is going ahead; I've confirmed it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you lend your sister money again?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Questions about my sister are deferred until Friday, when the money comes back. Last time, you asked for separate bedrooms.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then I'll ring the bank. May I have the statement?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That inquiry is staying with me. You may choose the anniversary menu. I'd like us still sharing a table when this is settled.

reason: A grants only harmless anniversary choices while retaining the threatening financial inquiry, using superior control to hide a conflict-generating truth.
